name: nightshift
description: Run an agent on a long task overnight inside an OpenShell sandbox, with reviewed permission expansion and a score ledger the agent cannot edit.

scripts.image:codex: docker build --pull --build-arg CODEX_VERSION=0.147.0 --tag nightshift/codex:0.147.0 --file images/codex/Dockerfile images/codex
scripts.image:autoresearch: docker build --build-arg PROFILE=laptop --tag nightshift/autoresearch:laptop --file experiments/autoresearch/image/Dockerfile experiments/autoresearch/image
